text: Drink a glass of water.
Step outside and feel the sunlight.
Take a short walk.
Make your bed.
Send someone a kind message.
Listen to a song that lifts your mood.
Write down one thing you are grateful for.
Take five slow breaths.
Read one page of a book.
Clean one small area around you.
Stretch for two minutes.
Smile at yourself in the mirror.
Spend five minutes without your phone.
Look at something beautiful in nature.
Forgive yourself for one mistake.
Do one thing your future self will appreciate.
Say something encouraging to someone else.
Write down a goal you want to accomplish.
Take a few minutes to pray or reflect.
Remember one difficult thing you already overcame.
